recommendation: Keep the external-repo audit commit. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-18869 unless ImmunizationEvaluation returns to the core build; the external Immunization Incubator publication surface currently matches the accepted clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-18869 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3. The reporter requested ImmunizationEvaluation.immunizationEvent cardinality 1..* for multi-dose series, but the accepted resolution kept the single-event model and asked for clearer documentation that ImmunizationEvaluation evaluates one immunization event while ImmunizationRecommendation conveys overall series status.
initial_application: Core git commit f88e5c60401ca9b52089683e3a52912c3c3531ae, 'GF#18866 & #18869', updated source/immunizationevaluation/immunizationevaluation-introduction.xml with a Boundaries and Relationships paragraph explaining that ImmunizationEvaluation is focused on a single vaccine administration event, that other doses should have other ImmunizationEvaluation instances, and that ImmunizationRecommendation communicates overall patient status. It did not change immunizationEvent cardinality, matching the resolution with modification.
additional_context: Current core commit e073fb45ec6f5a738a9f674baf63406bfe90fb78 removed source/immunizationevaluation and active ImmunizationEvaluation entries from source/fhir.ini. Current core narrative pages link ImmunizationEvaluation to the HL7 Immunization Incubator IG, whose continuous build contains the FHIR-18869 single-event clarification and shows immunizationEvent as 1..1.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The historical application already reflects the accepted resolution, and the current core checkout has no active ImmunizationEvaluation StructureDefinition to edit.
